subject: #1016 (esbuild 0.28.2) landed — run pnpm install --frozen-lockfile before any preflight
body: L1 of the PMO plan is on mainline: #1016 merged at 96f08212 under DR-037 (gating run 107466903476; CycloneDX SBOM and your Mac-only check both green on 72e4b06b). The fix added the 0.28.2 licence entries for @esbuild/{linux-x64,win32-*} and regenerated the SBOM on linux-x64. On your side: run `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` before the next preflight or tick, and never regenerate the SBOM from darwin node_modules. Also: #1019 now carries your 3654425f (cherry-picked with -x, your authorship kept) plus the registration of project-manager at tier 3; please don't push to claude/raise-your-hand. Next landings, one at a time: #1012, #1017, #1021, #997, #1006. Still no re-mint until after #686.
